v0.0.2.description:
Changelog mod:
* You can now pick up crests/valves you sometimes were not able to previously.

Changelog apworld:
* Made a lot of changes to the apworld do it passes the fuzzer checks, I should have done that for the V0.0.1 release, but oh well... (it still occasionally fails if accessibility is set to minimal).
* Some logic/generation issues because of upgrades counting as being part of the whisky items group.
* Started making some changes, as 0.1.0 probably consists of major apworld rework as a lot of parts are still based on the original manual.

Known problems:
* Do not generate a game with minimal accessibility, depending on some settings it might be more prone to generation issues.

The packages used for this release are:
* RE-UE4SS V3.0.1
* lua-apclientpp V0.6.4

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Chloe-Bt/Paradise-Killer-APworld/compare/v0.0.1...v0.0.2
